newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh proposes 81.62 bln taka budget deficit.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh proposes 81.62 bln taka budget deficit.

text.p: Bangladesh on Thursday proposed a 81.62 billion taka deficit budget for fiscal 1997/98 beginning July 1.
The annual budget placed by Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria in parliament evisaged revenue at 196.24 billion taka against expenditure of 277.86 billion.
According to the budget summary statement the budget deficit would be covered by expected foreign assistance worth 53.42 billion taka and domestic sources.
